name: guardrails
description: Safety guardrails for running Claude Code with reduced supervision. Ships the guard-destructive PreToolUse hook: hard-blocks catastrophic Bash commands (rm -rf /, rsync --delete, docker volume rm), and makes rm/rmdir scope-aware: an operation whose operands all resolve inside the allowed workspace (the session project root, the temp dirs, or any $GUARD_ALLOWED_EXTRA root) runs silently, while anything outside it (or any glob/variable that cannot be resolved before execution) raises a single reflective confirmation. git reset --hard / clean / restore, shred, dd, mkfs still always prompt.
